entries.source: A shadow traces across the floor.
entries.target: 一道阴影从地板上掠过。

entries.source: As you descend to the next level you traverse a kind of magical barrier keeping the water away. The barrier seems to be failing however and the next level is flooded too.
entries.target: 当你下到下一层时，你穿过了一道阻挡湖水的魔法屏障。然而这道屏障似乎正在失效，下一层同样被水淹没了。

entries.source: In rich families the dead are sometimes put to rest with some treasures. However they also sometime protect the coffins with powerful curses. Open?
entries.target: 富裕人家有时会以财宝为死者陪葬。然而他们有时也会用强大的诅咒来守护棺材。要打开吗？

entries.source: Corrupted heart of the Sandworm Queen
The heart of the Sandworm Queen, ripped from her dead body and corrupted in the mark of the spellblaze altar. You could ... consume it, should you feel mad enough.
entries.target: 从沙虫女皇尸体上割下的心脏，被魔法大爆炸之痕的祭坛所腐化。如果你够疯的话，你大可以……吃掉它。

entries.source: #00FFFF#You consume the heart and feel the corruption fill you!
entries.target: #00FFFF#你吃下了心脏，你感觉被腐化的力量充满！

entries.source: You have %d stat point(s) to spend. Press p to use them.
entries.target: 你有 %d 属性点数，按 P 键使用。

entries.source: You have %d class talent point(s) to spend. Press p to use them.
entries.target: 你有 %d 职业技能点数，按 P 键使用。

entries.source: You have %d generic talent point(s) to spend. Press p to use them.
entries.target: 你有 %d 通用技能点数，按 P 键使用。

entries.source: You are transformed by the corrupted heart of the Queen!
entries.target: 你被腐化的沙虫女皇之心所转化！

entries.source: #00FF00#You gain an affinity for blight. You can now learn new Vile Life talents (press p).
entries.target: #00FF00#你获得了与枯萎的紧密联系，现在你可以学习新的邪恶生命技能（按 P 键）。

entries.source:
This area appears to have been hit by a huge tremor, breaking the floor in a huge crack.
You think you can jump to the level below.
entries.target:
这块区域似乎经历过巨大的震动，将地板砸出了一个大洞。
你觉得你可以跳进下面的楼层。

entries.source: Some horrible power has twisted this brutish minotaur into something altogether more terrifying. Huge tentacles undulate from its back as it clenches and unclenches its powerful fists.
entries.target: 某种可怕的力量将这个野蛮的米诺陶扭曲成了更加恐怖的东西。巨大的触手在它背上起伏翻涌，它有力的拳头一握一松。

entries.source: and revived as a mindless horror
entries.target: 并将其复活为一只无心智的恐魔

entries.source: Have you hard about the patrol that disappeared in the maze in the west?
entries.target: 你听说过有一支巡逻队在西边的迷宫里失踪了吗？

entries.source: A fearsome bull-headed monster, he swings a mighty axe as he curses all who defy him.
entries.target: 一只可怕的牛头怪物，他挥舞着巨斧，诅咒所有胆敢违抗他的人。
并将其挂在墙上的长钉上

entries.source: Covered by eerie luminescent growths and protuberances, this spider now haunts the maze's silent passageways.
entries.target: 这只蜘蛛覆盖着诡异的发光增生和瘤状突起，如今出没于迷宫寂静的通道中。

entries.source: A diary, left by an adventurer.
entries.target: 一本冒险者留下的日记。

entries.source: Some notes describing how to create poison gas traps, left by an unfortunate rogue.
entries.target: 一些描述如何制造毒气陷阱的笔记，由一位不幸的盗贼留下。

entries.source: You can feel the psionic waves of power come from this yaech.
entries.target: 你可以在这只夺魂魔身上感受到庞大的灵能。

entries.source: A slithering noise accompanies the movement of this strange creature, whose snake-like tail gives rise to the body of a beautiful elf-like woman. As she moves her delicate hands water rises from the ground, and you feel that here is no mere monster, but a creature of awe and power.
entries.target: 这只奇怪的生物移动时发出滑行的声响，蛇一样的尾巴之上是美丽精灵般的躯体。当她移动纤细的双手时，水从地面升起，你感到面前的并非普通怪物，而是一个令人敬畏而强大的生物。

entries.source: Green eyes stare out from behind strands of long, golden hair, which falls down in waves over smooth, pale skin. Your eyes are drawn to the bare flesh, but as they look further they see dark scales stretching out into a long serpent's tail. You look up as she moves, her hair parting to reveal a slim and beautiful face with high cheekbones and full lips. Yet for all the allure of this wondrous creature the terror of the serpentine tail sends shivers down your spine.
entries.target: 一双绿色的眼睛从缕缕金色长发后凝视着你，那长发如波浪般垂落在光洁苍白的肌肤上。你的目光被裸露的肌肤吸引，但再往下看，就会见到黑色的鳞片一路延伸，化作长长的蛇尾。她一动，发丝分开，露出一张清瘦而美丽的脸庞，颧骨高耸，双唇丰润。然而，纵使这奇异生灵如此诱人，那蛇一般的尾巴带来的恐惧仍让你脊背发凉。
激流盘旋者纳纱瓦女士

entries.source: Water circles slowly on the ground around this naga's tail. Her dark tail is coiled tight, making her look short, but her calm and confident stare assure you that she will not be easily overcome. As the water begins to rise around her the air starts to shimmer, and you feel her dark eyes are penetrating into you deeper than is comfortable.
entries.target: 水流缓慢的围绕着这位娜迦的尾巴旋转。她黑色的尾巴蜷缩起来，使她看起来较为矮小，但是她沉着而自信的眼神让你确信她不是轻易就能被击败的。当周围的水位开始上涨，空气开始闪烁微光，你感到她漆黑的目光洞穿了你，让你很不自在。

entries.source: and brought back to Vargh for experimentations
entries.target: 并将其带回瓦尔弗做实验

entries.source: As you enter the lair you can hear the distorted sound of fighting. Somebody is already invading the lair.
entries.target: 当你进入巢穴时你听到了打斗的兵器撞击声。似乎已经有人入侵了这里。

entries.source:
This ancient bear long guarded the western side of the forest, but as of late he started growing mad, attacking even the Thaloren.
It seems to have fallen prey to the shivgoroth invading the area. Dead and frozen, it seems like a statue, animated by the elementals.
entries.target:
这只远古巨熊一直守护着西边的丛林，但是不知何时他变得疯狂并到处攻击自然精灵们。
它似乎已经成为了进入这片领地的寒冰元素的牺牲品，死去并且冻结，就像一座雕塑，被元素能量所支配。

entries.source: This ancient bear long guarded the western side of the forest, but as of late he started growing mad, attacking even the Thaloren.
entries.target: 这只远古巨熊一直守护着西边的丛林，但是不知何时他变的疯狂并到处攻击自然精灵们。

entries.source: and was feasted upon by wolves
Looking into the altar will let you experience a dream. Without the influence of Mindworm, it'll however have no power over your body. Do you wish to look?
entries.target: 这个祭坛可以让你体验梦境。然而，没有了心灵蠕虫的影响，它不会对你的身体产生任何实际影响。你想要看一看吗？

entries.source: This tall Thalore's eyes are lost in the distance; you can sense that he barely sees you.
entries.target: 这位高大的自然精灵目光望向远方；你能感觉到他几乎没看见你。

entries.source: As Mindworm dies you can feel the fumes getting less poisonous for your mind.
entries.target: 当心灵蠕虫倒下时，弥漫的烟气似乎不再侵袭你的心灵了。
